steps.text: The news board is shown. It is still empty — no news has been published yet. As a manager you can create one with the "New post" button.
steps.title: The news board

steps.text: Click "New post" in the top right to open the compose dialog.
steps.title: Open the composer

steps.text: The dialog opens on the "Post" kind. The "Poll" tab would create a poll instead — here we publish a plain news post.
steps.title: Compose a news

steps.text: Type your news content in the editor. The toolbar lets you format the text (headings, bold, lists, links).
steps.title: Write the message

steps.text: Click "Publish" to broadcast the news to every member of the community.
steps.title: Publish

steps.text: The news appears at the top of the board, signed by its author. Every member of the community sees it and receives a notification.
steps.title: Your news is published
